rows.note: Use 理想 as the all-purpose everyday choice for a positive personal aspiration or goal, without an excessive or power-seeking shade.

example.english: My ambition is to open my own café.
example.traditional: 我嘅理想係開間自己嘅咖啡店。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 lei5 soeng2 hai6 hoi1 gaan1 zi6 gei2 ge3 gaa3 fe1 dim3

rows.note: Use 上進心 when ambition means sustained drive to improve and get ahead rather than a particular goal.

example.english: They have a lot of ambition and still study after work.
example.traditional: 佢好有上進心，放工仲會自修。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jau5 soeng5 zeon3 sam1 fong3 gung1 zung6 wui5 zi6 sau1

rows.note: Use 野心 for ambition involving an excessive or aggressive desire for power, superiority, fame, or distinction.

example.english: That politician has huge ambition and wants to control the whole city.
example.traditional: 嗰個政客野心好大，想控制晒成個城市。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 zing3 haak3 je5 sam1 hou2 daai6 soeng2 hung3 zai3 saai3 seng4 go3 sing4 si5

rows.note: Use 期望 when the desire is directed toward another person’s success or achievement.

example.english: Our ambition for our son is for him to get into university.
example.traditional: 我哋對個仔嘅期望係佢入到大學。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 go3 zai2 ge3 kei4 mong6 hai6 keoi5 jap6 dou2 daai6 hok6
